limitations: Only model_final.pth was available for evaluation; no BPE model checkpoint was present.
Loss estimates use random context windows, not the complete validation corpus or an independent external test set.
Character prediction accuracy is not question-answering accuracy.
Single-turn generation samples use temperature 0.8 and fixed seeds; the sample set is too small for a general benchmark score.
The checkpoint contains no training-step metadata or loss history; convergence dynamics cannot be reconstructed.
Loss and perplexity per token cannot be directly compared across character and BPE tokenizers.
